# Psalm 144 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 144:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Of-David. Blessed YHWH my-rock, the-one-training my-hands for-battle, my-fingers for-war.
- **LOGOS:** Of David. Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands for war, and my fingers for battle;
- **PNEUMA:** By David. Praise the LORD, my rock! He trains my hands for battle and my fingers for fighting.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 144:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** My-steadfast-love and-my-fortress, my-stronghold and-my-deliverer, my-shield and-in-him I-take-refuge, the-one-subduing my-people under-me.
- **LOGOS:** he is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
- **PNEUMA:** He is my loving ally and my fortress, my tower of safety and my rescuer, my shield and my shelter. He brings nations under my authority.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **PNEUMA:** Reach down from heaven and pull me out! Rescue me from this flood of enemies — from these foreigners

- **EMET:** Our-storehouses full providing from-kind to-kind; our-flocks multiplying by-thousands, by-ten-thousands in-our-fields.
